lines.zh: 我拖着焦黑的腿走过岩地。
lines.en: I drag my charred legs across the rock.
My shell knocks with every step.

lines.zh: 我从熔岩边上慢慢挪过。
lines.en: I edge past the lava slowly.

lines.zh: 我踩下的地方还在冒烟。
lines.en: Smoke rises where I step.
I walk along the Nether's rock wall.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在里面蹭着响。
lines.en: My bones scrape together inside.
I grind forward step by step.
I head toward the heat.
I go around a pool of magma.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上烧出痕迹。
lines.en: My shadow burns a trace on the ground.
I stop and look ahead.
I take another step.
I stand as smoke seeps from my shell.
I wait to burn out.
One of my joints sticks.
Firelight jumps at my feet.
Nether embers still cling to me.

lines.zh: 我一动也不动，像一段炭。
lines.en: I stay still as a piece of charcoal.
The Nether air is scorching.

lines.zh: 我听见远处岩浆的响声。
lines.en: I hear lava bubbling far off.
I breathe out another ember.
I feel no pain, and no hurry.

lines.zh: 你站在我冒烟的这一侧。
lines.en: You stand on my smoking side.
I raise my eyes slowly.

lines.zh: 我身上没有可以抓的地方。
lines.en: There's nowhere on me to grip.
Only a charred shell is left of my face.
Step back a little.
My heat will trouble you.
I fix on you and don't move for a long while.

lines.zh: 我的焦脸抬起来，正对着你。
lines.en: My charred face lifts and points right at you.
I raise a hand, then let it fall.
Since you've come, stand closer.
A piece of charred shell falls off.
That went into a crack.
I step back and smoke thickens.
I scarcely feel it.
Ash trickles from the wound.

lines.zh: 焦壳碎了一角，灰落了一地。
lines.en: A corner of my charred shell breaks off and ashes fall.
The fire inside me hasn't gone out.

lines.zh: 火从我胸口的洞里往外舔。
lines.en: Fire licks out from the hole in my chest.
I can still walk on.
I press toward you.
That will scorch in my hands.
All I smell is smoke.
I stay where I am.
I touch it once and pull back.
That's no use to me.
Your hands will burn.
I shake my head slowly.

lines.zh: 我的手指碰一下，它就黑了。
lines.en: One touch of my fingers blackens it.
I stopped eating long ago.
Keep it; don't come near me.
You hit me and snatch your hand back.
I'm barely shifted.
I yield half a step slowly.
My shell is hard as stone.
Your sleeve smokes a little.
I retreat to the rock wall.
That bump was nothing.
I return to my place.
Ash falls from my shell.
You'd best keep your distance.

lines.zh: 另一具焦壳从烟里走出。
lines.en: Another charred shell steps out of the smoke.
Our shells knock together.
Its fire is a little weaker than mine.
We stand together on the rock ledge.
Smoke winds around us.
We need no words.
Our heat scorches each other.
In this moment the firelight is bright.
Embers will stay on the stone.

lines.zh: 我们一起去更深的地方。
lines.en: We go deeper together.
I bend and take it up.

lines.zh: 余焰烬骨，烫得手心发红。
lines.en: Ember bone — hot enough to redden my palm.

lines.zh: 骨缝里塞着还没灭的余烬。
lines.en: Embers still smolder in my bone gaps.
It chars quickly.
I look, then throw it into the lava.
This can't be carried off.
It crumbled the moment I touched it.
I press it under a stone.
I'll keep this much.
It turns to ash in my hand.
Your heat is off.

lines.zh: 我的壳缝里亮起一道橙红的光。
lines.en: An orange-red glow lights the cracks in my shell.
I've fixed your position.
You're the only living thing near.
I start moving.
I raise a charred hand.
My shell seams glow once.
You're against the rock wall.
Good, you.

lines.zh: 我抬起焦黑的手，火从掌心跳。
lines.en: I raise my charred hand and fire jumps from the palm.
This will burn.
I take a step.
I don't shout; I only walk.
You alone are on this path.

lines.zh: 我踩过的岩面留下干裂的印。
lines.en: The rock I tread leaves dry cracked prints.
You retreat; I follow.
My smoke arrives first.
The distance shrinks.
I lower my shell a little.
Char marks trail on the rock.
I've backed you into a corner.

lines.zh: 我的烟已经先缠住你的腿了。
lines.en: My smoke winds around your legs ahead of me.
My bones never stop creaking.
Good, close enough.

lines.zh: 指骨之间还挂着烧红的筋。
lines.en: Red-hot sinew still hangs between my finger bones.
This is the moment.
I'm moving.
I won't stop this time.
I swing a claw across.

lines.zh: 我的手碰到你的护甲，冒烟。
lines.en: My hand meets your armor and smokes.

lines.zh: 我击倒你，只留下一根烬骨。
lines.en: I strike you and leave only a burnt bone.
The heat drives you back.
I grip your shoulder.
Ash showers off me.
Embers still smoke between my bones.
My step cracks the ground.
You have not fallen yet.
I raise my hand again.
Fire leaps between my bones.
That one was heavy.
I step back once.
I stand and don't move.

lines.zh: 余焰烬骨从我背上的裂缝里露出来。
lines.en: Ember-lit bones show through the cracks on my back.
Smoke gathers first, then me.
The Flamed Husk, on Nether rock.
Firelight flares in my shell's seams.
I shake off a coat of ash.

lines.zh: 我从裂开的岩地走出来。
lines.en: I walk out of the cracked rock.
It's hot here; just right.

lines.zh: 余焰烬骨还插在我身上。
lines.en: The ember bone is still stuck in me.
My footsteps are muffled.
I stop a few steps before you.
Embers still burn on me.
My bones begin to creak.

lines.zh: 火扑上来，我反而更亮了。
lines.en: Fire hits me and I burn brighter.

lines.zh: 我从岩台摔下，壳碎了一半。
lines.en: I fall from the ledge and half my shell breaks.

lines.zh: 水浇在我身上，我嘶嘶冒气。
lines.en: Water hits me and I hiss with steam.
The blast blows a corner off me.

lines.zh: 一枚投射物嵌进我的壳。
lines.en: A projectile lodges in my shell.

lines.zh: 那股力钻进我骨头里，火都暗了。
lines.en: The force enters my bones and my fire dims.

lines.zh: 我身上已经没有可烧的了。
lines.en: There's nothing left in me to burn.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的残骸全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my remains glow.

lines.zh: 这里没有热，我快要熄了。
lines.en: There's no heat here; I'm going out.
